card.name: Inside beta-lactamase inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long drug names, mainly the 'act' in sulbactam and tazobactam, also 'am' in relebactam and 'anic' in clavulanic. It fires partway through the name, before the ending.

modes.label: -bactam names
modes.description: The 'act' or 'am' piece inside sulbactam, tazobactam and relebactam, usually in antibiotic combination products.

modes.label: Other long names
modes.description: Middle pieces of other long biochemical or drug names, such as clavulanic acid and alpha-1-antitrypsin.
